state:
**Goal `deprecated-and-todo`. Stages 2 to 5 are on disk, and Stage 6's setting is.** A `W1003` names its template filled in at the use and carries it as a safe fix (`nvs-types`), the editor shows it with its tag, quick fix, completion tag and hover, and `nvs check` lists todos, denies and fixes. The whole list of goal `php-oracle-retired` is the floor of Stage 1.

ADR 0275 is accepted and its rules are on disk as `designed`. The template check is `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated/template.rs` (`E0845` to `E0850`), `W1003` is raised by `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated.rs`, and the fix is `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated/fix.rs`. LSP tests: `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/deprecated.rs`. Todos and the `nvs check` flags: `crates/nvs-syntax/src/todo.rs`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/check.rs`, tests `crates/nvs-cli/tests/check_flags.rs`.

`[errors] deprecated` is `crates/nvs-config/src/errors.rs`: `Deprecated::{Ignore, Log, Throw}`, `Deprecated::in_force(&Request)`, `KEY`, and `validate` (`E0601`) called from `resolve.rs`. `Request::set` refuses a fourth value in `stays_meaningful`. The directive row is `errors.deprecated`, `Runtime`/`Reload`, and it is in `REQUEST_READ` of `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs`. Tests: the three `errors_deprecated_*` cases in `crates/nvs-config/tests/request.rs`. Nothing in the runtime reads the setting yet.

**Known gaps, not yet owned by a test:** a use inside a property initializer, a constant's value or a parameter default does not warn; a static call reached through a subclass names the declaring class; a passed deprecated parameter gets no fix (help only); a template with a closure, an interpolated string, a function call by name or a `static` gets no fix; completion tags a deprecated member but not a deprecated class name.

**One deviation for the user to confirm:** ADR 0275 § Diagnostics adds no code except the template refusals. The goal also asks that an attach site the attribute does not take be refused, and no existing code says that. `E0844` is that code. If it should go, `E0454` could carry the hook case instead, with a worse message.

items.text: **A deprecated method checks the setting on entry, any other deprecated declaration at its use, and a program with no deprecated use emits no check** — `rule:errors/a-use-of-deprecated-code-may-log-or-throw`: one context word beside `DebugFlags` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/mod.rs:278`, set per request from `nvs_config::errors::Deprecated::in_force` and again on `Core\Config::set`; the load and cold branch as the `DEBUG_FLAGS_OFFSET` load at `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:1163`; `Core\DeprecatedError`, a `LogicError`, in `crates/nvs-hir/src/errors.rs:96` and `crates/nvs-runtime/src/throwable.rs:318`. Test: the goal record's stage-6 `nvs-codegen` check (`a_deprecated_method_checks_the_setting_on_entry` and its two siblings).

**The conformance case** `tests/conformance/lang/a-deprecated-use-throws-only-when-the-setting-says-so.nvst` — `rule:errors/a-use-of-deprecated-code-may-log-or-throw`: `ignore` runs unchanged, `throw` throws `Core\DeprecatedError` naming the replacement, and a request's set does not reach the next one. Anchor `crates/nvs-runtime/src/throwable.rs:318`.

backlog: The `"log"` value's per-request site set and its `warning` record — `rule:errors/a-use-of-deprecated-code-may-log-or-throw`; no check in the goal record pins it yet.
